ticket.title: TaskKind has no docs variant although conventional commits accept it
ticket.description:
storypole add --kind docs is rejected with "unknown kind", listing epic, bug, refactor, tech_debt, spike, feature, chore. Conventional Commits v1.0.0 is the suite commit standard (law 7) and accepts docs, perf, test, style, ci and build, so a task whose work is documentation has no kind that describes it and gets filed as chore or feature - the same mismatch that made chore unusable before it was added. Docs is added here because it is the one this work needs; perf, test, style, ci and build are recorded as a deferred follow-up rather than added speculatively, since a kind nothing uses is a kind nobody validates.

LIVE 2026-11-08, installed binary v0.1.0-beta.5, in a scratch git repo:

  storypole add 'a documentation task' --kind docs
    -> Created task CO-1 [Docs] P3: a documentation task
  storypole list --json -> kind: docs
  storypole add x --kind perf
    -> unknown kind `perf`; expected one of: epic, bug, refactor, tech_debt, spike, feature, chore, docs

Committed 35c07a1 (common, contract) and 2efc5e2 (storypole, CLI plus MCP schema), merged to storypole main
as 2835745. Verified with the common chain, exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: storypole add --kind docs succeeds and the task round-trips as docs; the error listing for an unknown kind names docs; a test proves an existing ledger line with kind feature still replays; docs is added to the CLI value list and the MCP dispatch
